from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperData(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document regarding its identity and references."""
    own_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as written in the document")
    cited_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers found in the bibliography/reference list of this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The parsed output representing the information found in the processed document."""
    papers: list[PaperData]
